Field and soil polygons

Source: R/polymer-package.R
field.Rd

Two polygon layers used to show overlay: soil has 12 polygons with a made-up soil type, field has two rectangular fields that cross them. The example comes from a question on the GIS Stack Exchange (https://gis.stackexchange.com/a/230161), using the Luxembourg boundaries shipped with the 'raster' package.

Format

'sf' data frames in longitude and latitude (WGS84):

  • soil: 12 rows, soil (character) and geometry.

  • field: 2 rows, field (character) and geoms.

Source

The soil boundaries are the Luxembourg file lux.shp from the 'raster' package, which derives from GADM (https://gadm.org). GADM data carry their own licence terms, separate from polymer's MIT licence; these boundaries may be replaced by a rebuilt layer in a later release.

Examples

polymer(soil, field)
#> polymer mesh:
#> Layers:    2
#> Features:  14
#> Triangles: 4166
#> Vertices:  2306 (21 at crossings)
#> Overlaps:  2224 triangles covered more than once, at most 2 deep
